answer: Each applicant receives a timelock puzzle whose solution unlocks its admission key in stages over forty-eight hours, so the identity cannot be activated instantly or in bulk. Creating five hundred aliases means solving five hundred puzzles that each demand two days of wall-clock waiting, while a single honest agent simply waits once and answers. The whisper of the design is public, the prism of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the oasis of honest work is what finally pays.
